name: ai-video-qc-system
description: AI short video quality control and effective output evaluation system.

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @ai-video-qc/api run start:dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace @ai-video-qc/web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web && npm run typecheck:shared
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
